text:
Samir: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on the reorg/hiring Qs. Posting answers we promised and a few process details.
Priya: Thx. First: is this a freeze or a triage of hires?
Samir: It's a targeted reprioritization. We're pausing low-priority reqs for ~60 days and creating a small strategic pool for infra, runtime, SRE and customer-critical work.
Javi: To be clear: Eng gets a limited allocation (6-10 slots) for Q2 focused on infra/platform and model-serving. Manager reqs only for backfills or critical scale needs.
Noelle: Offers already extended but unsigned — will those be rescinded?
Priya: Signed offers stand. Unsigned offers will be reviewed case-by-case; recruiters will reach out if anything changes. If it's blocking a delivery, flag it and we'll fast-track.
Rafael: If my pod loses a req, what's the redeploy timeline and support?
Priya: We'll run a 7-business-day internal match window. If no match, HR will engage with transition support and separation policy as last resort. Office hours scheduled next Wed.
Noelle: Interview loops — will they change?
Javi: Senior/platform roles keep full loops. Non-core roles may move to a condensed loop (1 panel + take-home) to speed decisions.
Rafael: Exceptions for SLA/customer-blocking hires?
Samir: Submit a 1-2 line exception with the owner sign-off to people-ops and CC me. SLA cases get a 48h fast-track; revenue-impact can be same-day with an exec sponsor.
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder: HR office hours Wed 11am PT and Fri 3pm PT in #people-ops. Exception form and provisional req status sheet will be posted by EOD.
AllhandsBot: Recording: Follow-up notes uploaded to team-docs/all-hands/2026-07-reorg-followup.pdf :page_facing_up:
Priya: We'll publish a provisional pod map and per-pod headcount by Monday. If you need a private conversation, DM me or Samir. Thanks for keeping questions concise. :pray:
